newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mostly lower on spillover.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mostly lower on spillover.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mostly lower on spillover pressure from CBOT and KCBT wheat, traders said.
CBOT and KCBT wheat weakened on fading export prospects and on bearish comments made Monday by the CEO of Memphis-based analytical firm Sparks Companies.
"We pretty much traded in line with Kansas City and Chicago," a trader said.
The nearby December contract dropped sharply, partly on feelings that December had been overbought during Friday's rally, traders said.
"What really set the tone early was Atwood/Peavey selling 700,000 Dec bushels. They also bear-spread 1.5 million March/Dec at 45 cents," a trader said.
MGE spring wheat closed 12-1/2 cents per bushel lower to two cents higher, with Dec down 12-1/2 cents at $4.17-1/2. March gained two cents to close at $3.52.
Traders said apart from Atwood/Peavey, Wilson sold 2.3 million march bushels. LFG bought 2.3 million March and sold one million March.
MGE barley closed one to two cents per cwt higher, with March up one cent at $6.54.
